result.summary: 本文研究如何以最简单的方式实现测试时扩展（test-time scaling）并获得强推理性能 [S1.p1]。作者构建了仅含 1,000 个问题及其推理轨迹的小数据集 s1K，对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行监督微调，并提出 budget forcing 这一测试时技术来控制思考时长 [S1.p2]。得到的模型 s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24），并可通过 budget forcing 将 AIME24 性能从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。作者还通过消融实验表明，难度、多样性、质量三者联合的数据选择很重要，且 budget forcing 在可控性和扩展斜率上表现最佳 [S1.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在众多 o1 复现尝试中，尚无人公开复现出清晰的测试时扩展行为，因此作者追问实现测试时扩展与强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。其动机在于，o1 展示了测试时扩展带来的稳定收益，但未公开方法，而 DeepSeek R1 等复现依赖大规模强化学习和海量样本 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
o1 has demonstrated strong reasoning performance with consistent gains from scaling test-time compute.
DeepSeek R1 has successfully replicated o1-level performance, also employing reinforcement learning via millions of samples and multiple training stages.

method.text: 作者构建了 s1K 数据集，包含 1,000 个精心挑选的问题及其从 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏出的推理轨迹和答案，并在现成预训练模型上进行监督微调 [S1.p2]。测试时采用 budget forcing：若模型生成的思考 token 超过设定上限，就强制插入结束思考的 token 分隔符使其转入作答；若希望模型花更多测试时算力，则抑制结束思考 token 并追加“Wait”以鼓励更多探索 [S1.p2]。作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦于顺序式扩展 [S3.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: we construct s1K, which consists of 1,000 carefully curated questions paired with reasoning traces and answers distilled from Gemini Thinking Experimental.
If the model generates more thinking tokens than a desired limit, we forcefully end the thinking process by appending an end-of-thinking token delimiter.
we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and instead append “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace to encourage more exploration.
We focus on sequential scaling as intuitively we believe it should scale better, since later computations can build on intermediate results, allowing for deeper reasoning and iterative refinement.

experiments.text: 作者在推理密集型任务上对 s1-32B 进行基准测试，并变化测试时算力 [S1.F1]。测试时扩展的评估在 AIME24 上进行，用思考 token 数衡量算力，并定义 Control、Scaling、Performance 三个指标 [S3.SS2.p1]。消融实验针对数据选择与测试时扩展方法：随机选择、选最长推理轨迹或只选最大多样性样本都会导致性能显著变差（AIME24 上平均约 -30%），而在 59K 全量数据池上训练相比 1K 选择并无实质增益 [S1.p3]。测试时扩展方法消融在 AIME24 上比较了 budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control 和 rejection sampling 等 [S5.T3]。

evidence.quote: We benchmark s1-32B on reasoning-intensive tasks and vary test-time compute.
For each method we consider, we run a set of evaluations $a\in\mathcal{A}$ varying test-time compute on a fixed benchmark, e.g. AIME24.
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
Ablations on methods to scale test-time compute on AIME24.

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。通过 budget forcing 扩展测试时算力，可将 AIME24 性能从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。s1-32B 配合 budget forcing 的性能随测试时算力增加而提升，但最终在六倍处趋于平坦 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。在基础模型上用多数投票扩展测试时算力无法追上 s1-32B 的性能，验证了顺序式扩展比并行式更有效的直觉 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。数据选择方面，联合纳入难度、多样性、质量很重要，且 budget forcing 因具有完美可控性和清晰正斜率而带来最佳扩展 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24).
from 50% to 57% on AIME24.
it does eventually flatten out at six times.

Scaling test-time compute on the base model via majority voting cannot catch up with the performance of s1-32B which validates our intuition from §3 that sequential scaling is more effective than parallel.
we find that jointly incorporating difficulty, diversity, and quality measures into our selection algorithm is important.
Budget forcing leads to the best scaling as it has perfect controllability with a clear positive slope leading to strong performance.

limitations.text: 作者指出 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键局限：它最终会趋于平坦，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口的限制 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。作者还提到，继续测试时扩展需要能够进一步外推测试时算力的方法，并建议了改进 budget forcing 的可能方向 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p2]。

evidence.quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
Continuing test-time scaling will require approaches that can further extrapolate test-time compute.
